IVX HOLDINGS — CHAT FIX FINAL DEVICE QA, EVIDENCE CAPTURE, AND ACCEPTANCE

The code-level inverted FlatList implementation and deployment are accepted.

Do not change the chat implementation again unless real device QA finds a defect.

Do not mark the chat VERIFIED based only on source inspection, unit tests, deployment, or /health.

CURRENT STATUS

CODE FIX: DEPLOYED
GITHUB COMMIT: VERIFIED
PRODUCTION COMMIT: VERIFIED
ANDROID BEHAVIOR: NOT VERIFIED
IOS BEHAVIOR: NOT VERIFIED
WEB BEHAVIOR: NOT VERIFIED
FINAL STATUS: PARTIAL

==================================================
1. ENABLE OWNER DEVICE-QA EVIDENCE CAPTURE
==================================================

Add a temporary owner-only Chat QA panel or diagnostic mode that records:

- conversation_id
- active room ID
- first rendered message ID
- newest server message ID
- oldest rendered message ID
- message count
- list inverted status
- first content offset
- initialPositionApplied
- userNearLatest
- yellow-arrow visibility
- pagination cursor
- duplicate message count
- realtime subscription count
- last reconnect time
- app version
- commit SHA
- device platform
- timestamp
- trace ID

The diagnostic panel must:

- Be available only to the authenticated owner
- Never expose message contents or secrets
- Allow Copy QA Evidence
- Allow Export QA Report
- Be removable or disabled after certification

==================================================
2. ANDROID OWNER TEST
==================================================

The owner will perform this test on the real Android application.

TEST A — FRESH OPEN

1. Force-close IVX.
2. Reopen IVX.
3. Open IVX Chat.
4. Do not touch the screen for five seconds.

Required:

- Latest authorized conversation opens.
- Newest message is visible immediately.
- No visible movement through old messages.
- No yellow down-arrow appears.
- Composer remains visible.
- Message order is correct.

TEST B — SEND

1. Send one message.
2. Observe optimistic rendering.
3. Wait for server confirmation.

Required:

- Message appears once.
- No duplicate after server acknowledgment.
- Message remains at the latest position.
- Correct timestamp and status appear.

TEST C — RECEIVE

1. Receive one realtime response.

Required:

- Response appears once.
- Auto-scroll occurs only when already near latest.
- No order change after synchronization.

TEST D — HISTORY

1. Scroll upward into older history.
2. Trigger older-message pagination.

Required:

- Older records load.
- Visible position does not jump.
- Current message remains anchored.
- No duplicate page records.
- New incoming message does not force-scroll.
- New-message indicator appears.

TEST E — RETURN TO LATEST

1. Tap the yellow arrow or New Messages control.

Required:

- List moves directly to latest.
- Counter clears.
- Control disappears when latest is visible.

TEST F — KEYBOARD

1. Open keyboard.
2. Enter multiline text.
3. Close keyboard.
4. Open attachment control.

Required:

- Composer is not covered.
- Latest message remains visible where appropriate.
- No list jump.
- Draft survives temporary navigation.

TEST G — RESTART

1. Close the room.
2. Reopen it.
3. Restart the app and reopen chat.

Required:

- Correct latest conversation opens.
- Newest message is immediately visible.
- No stale scroll offset is restored.

==================================================
3. REQUIRED ANDROID SCREEN RECORDING
==================================================

Record continuously from:

APP FORCE CLOSE
→ APP OPEN
→ CHAT OPEN
→ SEND MESSAGE
→ RECEIVE RESPONSE
→ SCROLL TO OLD HISTORY
→ LOAD OLDER PAGE
→ RETURN TO LATEST
→ OPEN KEYBOARD
→ CLOSE AND REOPEN CHAT

The recording must visibly prove:

- No initial jump
- No immediate yellow arrow
- Correct order
- No duplicates
- Stable pagination
- Correct keyboard behavior

==================================================
4. INGEST OWNER QA RESULT
==================================================

Create an owner-only endpoint or workflow to attach:

- Screen recording reference
- Screenshots
- Device model
- Android version
- App build
- Test timestamp
- Pass/fail selections
- QA diagnostic export
- Owner comments

Link this evidence to the exact chat-fix task and commit.

Do not allow evidence from an older task to be reused.

==================================================
5. FIX ONLY WHAT FAILS
==================================================

If any Android test fails:

1. Mark final status FAILED or PARTIAL.
2. Identify the exact failed acceptance criterion.
3. Inspect diagnostic evidence.
4. Identify the exact file and root cause.
5. Modify only the required implementation.
6. Run targeted tests.
7. Commit.
8. Deploy.
9. Request a new owner recording.
10. Repeat until all Android tests pass.

Do not return another broad chat rewrite.

==================================================
6. WEB QA
==================================================

Test the live authenticated web chat in:

- Android Chrome
- Desktop Chrome
- Edge
- Safari or equivalent

Verify:

- Correct conversation opens
- Newest message visible
- No initial jump
- Message order
- Pagination
- Realtime
- No duplicates
- Responsive layout
- Browser refresh
- Back/forward navigation
- Keyboard/mobile composer behavior

Return browser screenshots, console results, trace IDs, and timestamps.

==================================================
7. IOS QA
==================================================

Run the same tests in a real iOS build.

If no iOS build or device is available, report:

IOS QA: BLOCKED
EXACT BLOCKER:
OWNER ACTION REQUIRED:

Do not mark iOS PASS from TypeScript, code review, Expo configuration, or Android results.

==================================================
8. FINAL CHAT ACCEPTANCE VALUES
==================================================

Return exactly:

ANDROID CHAT OPEN:
IOS CHAT OPEN:
WEB CHAT OPEN:
LATEST CONVERSATION SELECTED:
LATEST MESSAGE IMMEDIATELY VISIBLE:
VISIBLE INITIAL JUMP:
YELLOW ARROW ON INITIAL OPEN:
MESSAGE ORDER CORRECT:
DATE SEPARATORS CORRECT:
PAGINATION PRESERVES POSITION:
DUPLICATE MESSAGES:
REALTIME SEND:
REALTIME RECEIVE:
REALTIME RECONNECT:
KEYBOARD QA:
APP RESTART QA:
OWNER SCREEN RECORDING:
QA TRACE ID:
GITHUB COMMIT:
PRODUCTION COMMIT:
ALL COMMITS MATCH:

Required final values:

ANDROID CHAT OPEN: PASS
WEB CHAT OPEN: PASS
LATEST MESSAGE IMMEDIATELY VISIBLE: true
VISIBLE INITIAL JUMP: false
YELLOW ARROW ON INITIAL OPEN: false
MESSAGE ORDER CORRECT: true
PAGINATION PRESERVES POSITION: true
DUPLICATE MESSAGES: 0
REALTIME SEND: PASS
REALTIME RECEIVE: PASS
KEYBOARD QA: PASS
APP RESTART QA: PASS
OWNER SCREEN RECORDING: provided
ALL COMMITS MATCH: true

==================================================
9. FINAL VERDICT
==================================================

Only use:

VERIFIED — CHAT OPENS AT THE NEWEST MESSAGE

when actual device evidence passes.

Otherwise use:

PARTIAL — CODE DEPLOYED, DEVICE QA REMAINS
FAILED — CHAT DEFECT REMAINS
BLOCKED — DEVICE OR BUILD REQUIRED

STOP AFTER FINAL CHAT DEVICE QA.

Do not begin unrelated features until the owner chat recording has been reviewed.
